===
conditional preprocessor block preserves numeric labeled statement
===
program P;
label 10;
begin
  {$IFDEF FOO}
  10: Work;
  {$ENDIF}
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (declLabels
      (kLabel)
      (declLabel
        (labelNumber)))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (ppBlock
        (ppIf)
        (label
          (labelNumber))
        (statement
          (identifier))
        (ppEndIf))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
trailing numeric label remains a label
===
program P;
label 10;
begin
  Work;
  10:
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (declLabels
      (kLabel)
      (declLabel
        (labelNumber)))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (statement
        (identifier))
      (label
        (labelNumber))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
named labeled statement remains a labeled statement
===
program P;
begin
  L: Work;
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (label
        (identifier))
      (statement
        (identifier))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
conditional block preserves trailing numeric label

      (ppBlock

        (statement

        (label
          (labelNumber))
        (ppEndIf))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

conditional block preserves trailing empty numeric label

===
conditional block preserves trailing empty named label

  {$IFDEF FOO}

  {$ENDIF}

  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName

===
conditional block rejects missing label separator
===
program P;
begin
  {$IFDEF FOO}
  Work L:
  {$ENDIF}
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (ppBlock
        (ppIf)
        (label
          (identifier)
          (ERROR
            (identifier)))
        (ppEndIf))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
conditional unit implementation preserves procedure definition
===
unit U;
interface
implementation
{$IFDEF FOO}
procedure P;
begin
  Work;
end;
{$ENDIF}
end.

---

(root
  (unit
    (kUnit)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (interface
      (kInterface))
    (implementation
      (kImplementation)
      (ppBlock
        (ppIf)
        (defProc
          (declProc
            (kProcedure)
            (identifier))
          (block
            (kBegin)
            (statement
              (identifier))
            (kEnd)))
        (ppEndIf)))
    (kEnd)
    (kEndDot)))
